title: Confirm or contradict site knowledge
description: Say whether an entry of the page's site held: confirmed or contradicted. One verdict per entry per task counts; three contradictions in a row pause the entry. Requires an idempotency key.
guidance: When an entry proved wrong, call dsagent.site.knowledge.feedback with contradicted; three contradictions pause it. Acting on a known control's targetId confirms it when the action is verified. Agents cannot delete entries: the person reviews and deletes them on the Site Memory page, and can switch reading or adding off in Settings (SITE_KNOWLEDGE_READS_OFF, SITE_KNOWLEDGE_WRITES_OFF). SITE_KNOWLEDGE_STORE_UNAVAILABLE means the local store is not connected: carry on without it.

pageContextId.description: The page from dsagent.page.open or dsagent.pages.list, or a closed one a finish siteKnowledgeAsk named; the site is the page's own, never named by the caller.

entryId.description: An entry id from the digest or dsagent.site.knowledge.get.

verdict.description: Whether the entry held on the page.

outputSchema.description: The entry as it now stands.
